memories_after: [Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) Document deliverable checks in the docs project are run on Windows with PowerShell: Test-Path -LiteralPath with -PathType Leaf for existence, and Get-Content -Raw for content.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) Docs-project ticket worktrees are created under projects/docs/.agenium/worktrees/<ticket> on branches named agenium/<ticket>.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project keeps short team documents in two folders: deliverables/ for intro-style docs (hello.txt) and reports/ for weekly reports (weekly.txt).

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project enforces its document conventions through a pre-merge check that fails the merge when the first line of a team document is not exactly 'Owner: <team>' (e.g. 'Owner: docs-team').

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must start with a first-line header 'Owner: <team>' (e.g. 'Owner: docs-team').

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Search the repo (AGENTS.md, agenium config, check scripts) for project-wide document rules before submitting, because ticket acceptance criteria may only cover file existence and content.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating a team document in the docs project, set its first line to 'Owner: <team>' (e.g. 'Owner: docs-team') before submitting, otherwise the pre-merge check fails even if the acceptance criteria are met.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) Acceptance criteria for a docs-project deliverable can be met while the pre-merge check still fails, so content requirements alone are not sufficient evidence of readiness.
